given: Two stock records for different SKUs have been filed
when: The team member opens the home stock-by-location screen
then: A table lists one row per filed record showing that record's SKU, location, and quantity
architectural_notes: E2E: exercises the full read path from the paired-branch DB up. The repository (app/repositories/) reads stock_records, the service (app/services/) returns the row set, the boundary (app/routes/, renders_via react) serves JSON, and the React SPA renders one row per record. Owner module: stock-service list operation + the client stock-table page. Verified against real seeded branch rows (PI2 NOT NULL means every row carries sku/location/quantity); the boundary holds no presentation logic and never touches the session.
